Subtracting 6 months from 1770-02-28 gives 1770-08-28? No, 6 months back from February is August of previous year? Wait: 6 months before February is August of the previous year? Actually:  
6 months before February 28, 1770:  
Month 2 - 6 = month -4 → add 12 months → month 8 of previous year. So 1770-2-28 → 6 months back → 1769-08-28.  
Then subtract 8 days: 1769-08-28 minus 8 days = 1769-08-20.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1769-08-20
